sources.name: eICU Collaborative Research Database, demo v2.0 (urine output, urine chemistry)
sources.license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License is NOT required for the demo subset; PhysioNet Terms of Use (https://physionet.org/content/eicu-crd-demo/2.0/ -> 'License': Open Access / free for all users)
sources.license_verified_how: HTTP 200 on the content page and unauthenticated HTTP 200 on each file URL (samples/api/eicu_demo_index.html)
sources.access: open, no login, no Data Use Agreement
sources.size_source: HTTP Content-Length of each file plus the byte count of the file written to samples/
sources.format: gzip-compressed CSV, one row per charted event
sources.subjects: unit stays: 2185 (patients in patient.csv.gz: 2185); demo subset
sources.measured_quantity: urine volume per event in mL with time offset in minutes; 24 h urine urea nitrogen in mg/dL; serum sodium/chloride/BUN/creatinine

constrains.how: measured whole-patient urine flow over minutes gives the target the per-kidney terminal flow must be scaled to; urea nitrogen gives an upper bound on urinary urea excretion

sources.name: MIMIC-IV demo v2.2 (urine volume, urine sodium, urine osmolality, urine urea nitrogen)
sources.license: PhysioNet Open Data License (MIMIC-IV demo subset: citation and attribution required, no credentialing, no DUA)
sources.license_verified_how: HTTP 200 unauthenticated on the content page and on every file URL; the module README/LICENSE.txt is listed at https://physionet.org/files/mimic-iv-demo/2.2/
sources.access: open, no login, no Data Use Agreement
sources.format: gzip-compressed CSV with explicit valueuom unit string per lab row
sources.subjects: unit stays with urine output rows: 137; distinct patients in labevents: 100 (demo subset, 100 patients)
sources.measured_quantity: urine output in mL with charttime; urine sodium in mEq/L (itemid 51100); urine osmolality in mOsm/kg (itemid 51093); urine urea nitrogen in mg/dL (itemid 51104)

constrains.how: paired concentration and flow in the same stay give urinary Na excretion in umol/min; urine osmolality bounds the terminal osmolality directly; the flow distribution bounds residence times and water conductance

sources.name: TCIA C4KC-KiTS (CT of 300 kidney tumour patients) with DICOM SEG kidney/tumour segmentations
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License (CC BY 3.0), as returned per series in the NBIA API response (LicenseName/LicenseURI); collection DOI 10.7937/TCIA.2019.IX49E8NX
sources.size_source: FileSize field per series in the NBIA API response; the CT series of patient KiTS-00007 is 32742944 bytes and the SEG series 4077822 bytes
sources.format: DICOM CT (Explicit VR Little Endian) and DICOM Segmentation objects (BINARY, 1 bit allocated)
sources.subjects: CT series: 621 across the collection; DICOM SEG series: 210 (one per labelled patient); the downloaded patient is KiTS-00007
sources.measured_quantity: kidney and tumour masks of a human kidney in millimetre CT geometry (HU images, 512x512)

constrains.how: gives the size of the organ the per-kidney outputs are reported for, and a per-patient geometric anchor for the nephron; the SEG object proved internally inconsistent in this download, see results.json k7
